scope: Preimplementation review of approved-spec9 LIB5A pure contract invariants; no source or real transport implementation
outcome: Coherent bounded LIB5A preparation requirements; no specification blocker identified

required_invariants.rule: Strict raw UTF8, maximum 2,000,000 bytes and 12 container levels checked before unsafe parse allocation; no duplicate decoded keys, unknown keys, nonfinite numbers, unsafe sequence or unsupported version. Errors never contain payload.
cases: invalid UTF8 and unpaired surrogate handling

required_invariants.rule: Envelope has exactly9 specified fields; stream is normalized source-peer/destination-peer/scope tuple. All UUID references use canonical hyphenated case-insensitive text; opaque namespaces do not become peer credentials. Sequence 0 requires null predecessor; later sequence requires lowercase 64-hex predecessor.
cases: compact/URN/braced UUID refusal on every nested field

required_invariants.rule: Declare payload has exactly sample_handle,measurement_handle,protocol_version,context,measurement,synthetic_claim. Context/protocol and camera/instrument retain existing bounded units. RGB never has wavelengths or certified calibration; instrument data stays declaration.
cases: camera 3 finite fraction means/std,positive bounded integer pixel count,strict card bool,uncalibrated only
instrument 3–10,000 aligned bands,strictly increasing 200–25,000 nm,fraction reflectance/uncertainty

required_invariants.rule: Retire payload has exactly sample_handle and unique 0–100 normalized measurement_handles; sample-wide coverage is independent of list length. Parsing alone neither authenticates retirement nor performs erasure.
cases: empty list valid but still sample-wide semantic
measurement list cannot narrow covered sample

required_invariants.rule: Digest/idempotency covers exact owned UTF8 input bytes, separate from normalized typed data. Preserve bytes for retries; no cross-language canonicalJSON or signature claim. Same event identity cannot move streams/slots; same slot cannot change identity or bytes.
cases: UUID spelling/key-order/whitespace/float representation changes conflict for an existing ID
cross-stream sameID and differentID same-slot conflicts
input-buffer or nested model mutation cannot silently change the owned retry bytes

required_invariants.rule: Pure helpers decide contiguous chain/conflict outcomes only from explicit supplied synthetic prior state. Gaps never advance head; retirement restriction is independent of chain progress. Real authority, durable tombstones and ledgers belong later packages.
cases: authenticated fake retirement-before-declare restrains immediately with unchanged head
late covered declare never becomes scientific payload while in-memory chain validation may proceed
conflict stops normal progression but cannot disable restriction

required_invariants.rule: All received evidence stays private/unverified. synthetic_claim true is restrictive; false never verifies field data. Schema/digest success is not sender authentication, original-grant consent, physical pairing, scientific truth or publication eligibility.
cases: no global digest index/cross-contributor matching/membership query
peer and phone/node identities remain distinct

required_invariants.rule: Only pure validation, exact-byte helpers and shared synthetic TS/Python corpus. No filesystem export, credentials, environment-based authority, HTTP/listener, migration, new dependency, actual node sender or field training. Durable quotas/fences/disk/cleanup simulation belong 5B; live authority/transport remain owner-held 5C.
cases: strict conformance accepted/rejected parity in both languages
fail-before evidence for every refusal class
no successful source validation counted as peer permission or physical sample verification

implementation_alignment_points: Settle strict integer lexeme policy identically in TS/Python: Python strict-int rejects 1.0 / 1e0 while JavaScript JSON.parse loses that distinction. Cover stream_sequence and camera pixel_count; document -0 behavior without assuming canonical-number hashing.
Define depth counting consistently at the root and both object/array containers; test exact 12 / 13 boundaries.
Do not reuse complete LIB1 records or lax UUID coercion; construct exact exchange allowlists and canonical text checks for nested references.
Use immutable/copy-owned raw input for digest/retry, with normalized identifiers kept separately; typed models or readonly annotations do not certify unchanged nested data.
Keep 5A pure chain/idempotency decisions distinct from 5B durable filesystem/fake-authority semantics and 5C real authority/credentials/transport.
authority_limit: Owner architecture approval and actual specification merge are prerequisites for implementation. Ordered merge authorization does not open production, capture, real sharing or LIB5C decisions.
not_verified: No implementation candidate, exported API names or actual conformance behavior was reviewed
No runtime, filesystem, transport, capacity or scientific/privacy performance measured
